notes: CrimsonSaveEditor v1.0.11 (fork build) - the item.paloc entry stream is now decoded as an LZ4 block (16712 entries on the current install instead of 6 plain literals) and names resolve from each install root's own table, so DLC items keep their real names; item_db, armor_catalog and the GUI now share one normalizer, and the bundled item data was rebuilt (2223 identifier-only names down to 67 genuine single-word names)
